title: Cross-company adoption rule
summary: Treat list/row/filter/sort/selection mechanics as shared Wire UI platform capability across FlyLo and Federation-company UIs. Application-specific code supplies domain facts and semantic actions; it must not fork the generic row authority model.
continuation_rule: Before implementing a local list/table renderer, inspect the current shared Wire UI Server/Builder/renderer contracts and consume the latest qualified platform implementation. Only add application-specific code for domain projection or semantic actions.
